bullets: Increase intraday momentum sizing threshold from 1.0% to 1.2% of equity to allow trades like QQQ/IWM ($2,126–$2,486 loss) that narrowly exceed current limits
Reserve capital for the carry book (currently "no reserved capital") to enable vol_carry strategies (e.g., DIA iron condors with $546–$668 max loss)
Expand IV rank ceiling above 85% for vol_carry strategies, as 79 rejections cite IV rank 100% hitting the ceiling despite high IV-RV spreads (7.5–7.7%)
Adjust liquidity filter criteria for SPY/IWM/qqq: 25+ symbols failed due to "no contracts survived," suggesting overly strict OI or bid-ask requirements
Narrow lunch window (11:30–13:30) to 12:00–13:00, as 112 rejections occurred in early/midday but 40+ were at 12:34–13:03 (post-lunch recovery period)
Add IV rank data fallback for symbols like TLT/XLE (112 "no IV rank available" rejections) by using sector ETF proxies or historical volatility estimates
Align intraday book leasing ($15,000) with sizing rules: 1.0% of $100k = $1,000 risk per trade, but leased capital is 15x higher, suggesting misalignment between risk and capital allocation
